risk_note: RV2 settlement (settlement-plan B2-04s; BR-FUND-08, BR-FUND-01 R8/R9/R9b, BR-CALC-02/13). Clawback orchestration: apply() for commission / rights causes and onUpdated() from order sync; R8 full clawback (beneficiaries and platform) when the new base or N reaches 0, R9 partial clawback by the BR-CALC floor split, R9b, and WAIT_COMMISSION when the union has not reported the new commission yet. All writes inside the order lock with in-lock re-read; vouchers via ledger with uniq_keys (replay idempotent); rebate state only through the generated transition(). JD union commission >0 -> 0 (D10-313): R8 full clawback plus one recon diff type union_mismatch, open, resolution.reason_code COMMISSION_ZERO, deduped. Rights-success entry left as TODO blocked on B2-04l; R1 must-not-auto-close is out of scope (followup).
